_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for every responsive breakpoint in this app. Change a number here and it propagates everywhere: Tailwind config, every component's inline <style> media query (via lib/breakpoints.ts), and globals.css (via the auto-generated app/breakpoints.generated.css, rebuilt automatically before every dev/build run). Never hardcode a raw pixel number in a @media query anywhere else in the codebase.

_deviceGuide.mobileXxsMax: 341–380px — iPhone SE and similarly narrow phones
_deviceGuide.mobileMax: 482–599px — the general mobile ceiling used almost everywhere
_deviceGuide.tabletSplitMax/Min: 767/768px — secondary split inside the tablet range (small vs. large tablets), used by nav height + a few content sections
_deviceGuide.navCollapseMax: 860px — the nav's own collapse point; a deliberately separate, coarser threshold than the content-level tablet/laptop split
_deviceGuide.tabletMax/laptopMin: 1024/1025px — tablet ↔ laptop boundary (e.g. iPad landscape vs. small laptop)
_deviceGuide.laptopNarrowMax/laptopWideMin: 1180/1181px — narrow vs. wide laptop (nav fully expands here)
